body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated 5xx rate detected on production gateway (/api/generate). Error rate 5xx spike from 0.3% -> 7.8% in last 2m. P99 latency increased. Paging oncall. thread_ts=2955556789

Mei Jia: acked. I'm on-call for infra, jumping in.

Alex Chang: I'm seeing the same in Grafana. Errors are mostly 502/504 from upstream and a burst of 503. Top client path is /api/generate. Looks correlated with a config rollout ~7m ago.

Priya Nair: I pushed an Envoy route change 8m ago to fanout requests to a new backend pool for the new embeddings service (canary). Also bumped retries from 1 -> 3 for that route to improve transient reliability.

Mei Jia: that could amplify traffic. Are retries configured to respect timeouts?

Alex Chang: Checking envoy stats and upstreams now.

Alex Chang: envoy cluster frontend-gateway upstreams show spike in `upstream_rq_5xx` and `rq_active` for cluster `svc-embeddings-v2`. Circuit breakers (`cx_overflow`) are also rising. Looks like retry amplification into a partially ready pool.

Samir Patel: copying command outputs: ```
# k get svc -n prod
NAME                 READY   AGE
svc-embeddings-v2    1/3     12m
svc-embeddings-v1    3/3     40d
```

Alex Chang: logs from envoy (gateway) show a lot of 502 from svc-embeddings-v2: ```
[warning] upstream request failed: 502, host: svc-embeddings-v2.prod.svc.cluster.local
[info] retrying request (attempt 2)
[warning] upstream request failed: 502
[error] rate limited circuit open for cluster svc-embeddings-v2
```

Mei Jia: ok immediate mitigation options: 1) disable retries at gateway route 2) reduce route fanout weight to new pool 3) roll back route to previous config 4) temporarily route to v1 only. Which is fastest?

Alex Chang: fastest is to flip weight -> 0 for svc-embeddings-v2 (remove canary) + disable retries. I'll prepare the patch.

Priya Nair: I can revert the route patch. But flip weight is less disruptive.

Alex Chang: Applying quick patch to envoy route config now (using service control plane): ```
# PATCH apply
route: emb-route
- clusters: [svc-embeddings-v1, svc-embeddings-v2]
+ clusters: [svc-embeddings-v1]
retry_policy: disabled
```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollout for config revert by Alex Chang — change_id=cfg-8492 — monitoring 2m.

Mei Jia: also bumping circuit breaker capacity on svc-embeddings-v1 to buy headroom (temp). Running: `kubectl -n prod patch cm envoy-cb --patch '{"max_connections":2000}'`

Samir Patel: Support / CS check: Eve, do we have customer impact list?

Eve Li: checking error logs against customer API keys. Initial hit list: AcmeCorp (10% of requests), BetaApps (7%), internal tests. A subset of customers saw 5xx between 11:42-11:52 UTC. Raising SEV2.

Alex Chang: Post-change monitoring: within 60s error rate dropped to 1.1% overall, p99 latency improving. Keep watching.

incident-bot: Alert suppressed for route cfg-8492 revert, will auto-unmute if 5xx > 2% for 3m.

Priya Nair: I reverted the canary config and filed an action item to run a readiness check for new pool before enabling retries. My bad on the rollout sequencing.

Mei Jia: Good blunting step. Next: ensure retry budget/hedging is enabled so we don't over-amplify, and add readiness gate to rollout pipeline. Also consider per-host max_retries=1.

Alex Chang: I'm going to add a short-term rule to ensure `num_retries=1` and `per_try_timeout` is set smaller than the route timeout. Also adding a dashboard panel to show `retry_requests` vs `upstream_5xx` correlation.

Samir Patel: from support: notifying impacted customers: AcmeCorp engineer pinged in private, we're sending status note. I'll coordinate with Eve for RM/CS updates.

Eve Li: Sent messages to account reps. Triage note: ETA for full rollback verification ~15m.

Mei Jia: Ops notes for postmortem: - root cause: route fanout to partially healthy pool + increased retries created amplified traffic and upstream failures - immediate mitigation: remove canary weight + disable retries - long term: enforce readiness + retry budget + circuit breaker tuning + pipeline gating - customer impact: limited to ~17 minutes window, AcmeCorp and BetaApps had elevated errors, support notified

Alex Chang: adding links to config PR and rollback: https://git.internal/infra/changes/cfg-8492 and dashboard https://grafana.internal/d/xyz/5xx-spike

Priya Nair: making a follow-up PR to add readiness probe gating to the canary rollout and limit retries to 1. Will assign to Mei for review.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 — error rate trending down.

Samir Patel: handing off to night oncall — Mei, do you want me to take a full writeup or will you?

Mei Jia: I'll start the timeline and Samir, can you take postmortem template and draft customer-facing summary? I'll finish config details.

Samir Patel: on it. Passing oncall to Priya for the next 30m while I prepare notes. Priya, please ack if you can watch for any regression.

Priya Nair: acked. watching logs & envoy stats.

Alex Chang: thanks all — monitoring shows stable. :white_check_mark:

Eve Li: Customer communications sent. Will reopen if any regression.

incident-bot: thread auto-archived after 30m of stable metrics.
